messages:
Alex: Heads-up — merging the migration-guide PRs tomorrow morning. Who's on reviewer duty for docs today? Need to clear CI previews by 9am PT.
Maria: I can take PR #4823 (migration-guide: Dedicated→Private section). Could someone else take the SDK snippet review?
Sam: Happy to do the SDK snippet and the link fixes. Ping me the PR numbers and I'll run a local snippet test.
Josh: I'm oncall but can do a quick pass on two smaller PRs after 7am PT. If the CI preview fails we should hold merges.
Alex: PR list: #4823 (migration-guide), #4831 (sdk-snippet ruby), #4835 (link fixes). @maria take #4823, @sam take #4831, @josh take #4835?
Maria: :thumbsup: assigned. I'll run `mkdocs serve` locally before CI.
Sam: Quick heads-up — ruby snippet is failing lint on CI because it uses an older gem. I'll try to patch the snippet or vendor the dependency.
ci-bot: Build preview for PR #4831 failed: `docs-preview` image missing ruby 3.2.2. Logs: https://ci.example/4831
Josh: If the CI image needs a change we should avoid touching infra right before the merge window. Maybe merge #4823 and #4835 and hold #4831 until the gem issue is fixed.
Alex: Agreed. Plan: merge #4823 and #4835 after green CI. Hold #4831. @docs-oncall can someone update the preview image later today? cc @maria @sam
Maria: Filing an infra ticket: INF-892 to get the image updated, linking the CI logs.
Sam: I'll open a quick follow-up PR (#4831-fix) that vendors the needed ruby gem as a stopgap.
Alex: Great — thanks. I'll wait for CI to be green and then merge in the morning (target 8:50am PT) unless anyone objects. :rocket:
